name: Drag Tap
hook: Launch on green. Shift on green. Ten seconds.
how: Up to six cars line up. Tap on green to launch, then tap each time the rev needle hits the green zone to shift up. Perfect shifts give a kick, early ones bog down, late ones bounce off the limiter. Best time wins.
controls: Space, Enter or click to launch and shift; on phones, tap the big button
uses: One player's browser lights the tree, sets the lanes and posts the results; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot drivers with their own reactions and shifting fill the empty lanes.
Every car moves for everyone as its driver launches and shifts.
ideas: Add a nitro button you can use once per race
Let players pick their car's color and number before the race
Make it a night race on a rainy strip with slippery launches
